title: Learning nonlinear interactions and cross-feature couplings with product-unit residual networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.18074v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding nonlinear feature interactions is crucial in science and engineering, yet standard multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) often capture such interactions only implicitly, leading to entangled representations that can impair robustness and interpretability. We investigate complex-valued product-unit residual networks (CV-PURe) that integrate multiplicative product units with residual connections to explicitly model cross-feature couplings while stabilizing optimization. We conduct a systematic evaluation on an interaction-driven synthetic benchmark and real-world datasets and evaluate prediction together with input-level interaction recovery under a reproducible protocol. Across five data splits and five training seeds, CV-PURe achieves the lowest mean RMSE on four of six scientific benchmarks, reducing Friedman error by 53.9% relative to MLP. Its Friedman interaction maps assign 60.7% of total strength to the known interacting pair,

translated_title: 基于乘积单元残差网络学习非线性交互与跨特征耦合
translated_abstract: 理解非线性特征交互在科学与工程中至关重要，然而标准多层感知机（MLP）往往只能隐式地捕捉这类交互，导致表示相互纠缠，从而损害鲁棒性和可解释性。我们研究了复数值乘积单元残差网络（CV-PURe），该网络将乘法乘积单元与残差连接相结合，在稳定优化的同时显式地建模跨特征耦合。我们在一个交互驱动的合成基准和真实世界数据集上进行了系统评估，并在可复现的协议下同时评估预测性能和输入级交互恢复能力。在五次数据划分和五个训练种子下，CV-PURe 在六个科学基准中的四个上取得了最低的平均 RMSE，相比 MLP 将 Friedman 误差降低了 53.9%。其 Friedman 交互图将 60.7% 的总交互强度分配给已知的交互对，
tldr: 提出复数值乘积单元残差网络（CV-PURe），通过将乘法乘积单元与残差连接结合来显式建模跨特征耦合，在多个科学基准上预测误差显著低于MLP，并能有效恢复输入级的特征交互关系。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes complex-valued product-unit residual networks (CV-PURe), which integrate multiplicative product units with residual connections to explicitly model cross-feature couplings, achieving substantially lower prediction error than MLPs on scientific benchmarks while recovering input-level feature interactions.
